author: Ann Buckeridge
text: I have always been told not to put my sensors through the scanner. I walk through and get hand searched and swabbed my medical bag gets hand searched too. Even a member of security staff said that the sensors should not go through the scanner.

author: Tina Willavoys
text: I always carry them in my hand luggage. The scanners don’t effect them I also go through the body scanner wearing mine and have had no problems
